column1: # Val Ark - developer-stack run checks: does the mirrored build for THIS box start, offline?
# Read by scripts/lib/devstack.js (checks) for scripts/verify.sh verify_devstack, which
# takes the newest mirrored version, pulls the one binary into a temp dir, runs it with a
# timeout and records PASS / FAIL / SKIP per project in state/verify.json. Nothing is installed.
#   ref     the project's ref in data/dev-stack.tsv (exactly)
#   file    regex (JavaScript) over the file names of the newest version. Only files for the
#           host platform are tried (linux-x86_64 / linux-arm64 / macos-arm64, inferred from
#           the name as on the Developer stack page), so the regex only has to pick the
#           right archive among those. May contain '|'.
#   binary  path of the program inside the archive ('*' wildcards allowed; only that member
#           is unpacked), or '.' when the file is the program itself (bare, .bz2 or .xz).
#           More members may follow, space-separated, when the program cannot start
#           without them (go needs to see its own pkg/tool folder).
#   expect  extended regex (grep -E) the output must match. Must not contain '|'.
#   keepassxreboot/keepassxc, ventoy/Ventoy   GUI / installer apps: nothing to run headless
#   adoptium/temurin*-binaries                java needs the whole JDK tree unpacked (~300 MB per run)
